about: [O7 after the critic, B3] the bare hand in the street: LMB with nothing drawn throws the jab on the press (the hands up, the swing, the whiff), the hands go down a breath after; at the wanted man's back, at arm's length, the jab starts O4's fist fight with him at once.

steps.label: LMB on the press: the fist swings (the hands drawn)

steps.eval: (() => { const b = G.night.bounty.names()[0]; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(b.x, b.z); const g = G.night.graph(); let px = b.x + 1.3, pz = b.z; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i * Math.PI / 8, q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + Math.cos(a) * 1.3, 0, b.z + Math.sin(a) * 1.3); const q0 = q.clone(); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.4); if (q.distanceTo(q0) < 0.05 && g.lineOfSight(q.x, q.z, b.x, b.z) && !G.stage.part('city').C.inWater(q.x, q.z)) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.05); G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(px, pz, 30); return [b.name, Math.round(px), Math.round(pz)]; })()

(() => { const M = G.night.bounty.men.get('b0'); M.c.yaw = Math.atan2(M.pos.x - G.eye.x, M.pos.z - G.eye.z); const e = N.controller.pos; N.controller.yaw = Math.atan2(-(M.pos.x - e.x), -(M.pos.z - e.z)); return M.mode; })()

steps.label: a jab at his back: the fist fight with him
